integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only the exact three point-mass ratios, the identities relating lambda, Delta, and pq, and monotonicity in the total mean at fixed Delta. The bundled checker is a regression test and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only Poisson-binomial laws with at most two active Bernoulli parameters. It does not settle the Dümbgen--Wellner conjecture for three or more active parameters, and an equivalent elementary two-parameter calculation could exist in older relative-error literature under different terminology.
title: A log-two phase transition for two-Bernoulli Poisson density ratios
